summary: Frontend-only acceptance regression executed on public URL for iterations 28-32 targets. Core routing and marker interaction are stable, but strict exact-stop acceptance is not fully met (timeline exact 0.305 and desktop legacy six-stats visibility).

ui_bugs.issue: All six legacy stat cards remain opacity: 0 on desktop after routing to legacy (active=legacy, traveling=false), making the six stats effectively hidden.

integration_issues.issue: Desktop 5/5 batch reached timeline each run, but one run landed at stop=0.3045679012 (not exact 0.305). Mobile 5/5 consistently landed at stop=0.3049850799 (approximate, not exact 0.305).

action_items: Fix desktop legacy stat visibility regression: ensure six legacy stat cards are visible (not opacity 0) when data-active='legacy' and data-traveling='false'.
Harden route settle math for strict exact stop targeting so timeline lands at exact 0.305 for both desktop and mobile acceptance batches (not approximate values).
Re-run strict uninterrupted acceptance batch after fixes: timeline desktop 5/5 exact 0.305 and mobile 5/5 exact 0.305.
critical_code_review_comments: Pointer interception mitigation appears correct: marker-hit circle receives elementFromPoint and is directly clickable; decorative marker layers remain non-interactive.
Back-to-circuit flow preserves overview state correctly (data-overview='true') and retains chapter context label.

Current settle logic still yields fractional drift near target stops on some viewport/device combinations, indicating precision/normalization mismatch between computed top and resulting scroll progress.
context_for_next_testing_agent: What passed: timeline marker route activation 5/5 desktop and 5/5 mobile by active-state checks; cars marker reached ~0.37 on desktop/mobile; Enter and Space on timeline marker route correctly; back-to-circuit kept overview state; no horizontal overflow; no in-page .error elements. What failed strict acceptance: timeline not numerically exact 0.305 in all runs/devices; desktop legacy six stats remain hidden via opacity 0.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (timeline exactness): Repro by jumping to circuit and clicking timeline marker in uninterrupted loops. Active route settles to timeline, but normalized stop can resolve to nearby fractional values (0.3045679 desktop run; 0.3049850 mobile), suggesting precision drift from runway/viewport math and settle synchronization. RCA-2 (legacy stats desktop): Repro by immediate route to legacy on desktop and waiting >3s; each legacy stat node exists but computed opacity remains 0 while container is active/visible. Likely animation/state gating conflict tied to legacy-enter timeline under desktop conditions.
